meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 当用户询问未发布的更改时，Claude会比较当前代码与最新发布的npm版本，按三个发布层列出所有未发布更改，说明每处改动的实际内容和影响，并给出各层与整体的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“unpublished changes”“changelog”“what changed”等关键词，或要求查看未发布更改、变更日志时触发。

say.text: 看看有哪些未发布的更改
say.note: Claude会对比HEAD与最新npm版本并分层列出。

say.text: 对比当前代码和最新npm版本，列出所有变更
say.note: 会给出每个发布层的feat/fix/refactor说明。

say.text: 按发布层给我展示未发布的changelog

howto.what_en: When asked about unpublished changes, Claude compares HEAD with latest published npm versions, lists unpublished changes by release layer, explains real changes, and suggests version bumps per layer and overall.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like “unpublished changes”, “changelog”, “what changed”, or asks to review unpublished changes or changelogs.

say_en.note: Claude compares HEAD with latest npm version and lists layers.

say_en.text: Compare current code with latest npm versions and list all changes
say_en.note: Provides feat/fix/refactor descriptions per release layer.

say_en.text: Show the unpublished changelog grouped by release layer
say_en.note: Covers pure components, opencode, and codex layers.
